title: KEY SCALE
description: A key track and a free 12-note scale remap. T9's note trigs set the key (note - 60, C5) and are silent; the key is added to the notes of the tracks with transpose on, then the scale table remaps each note's pitch class on the tracks with scale on. FUNC + TRIG opens stock Quantize; pressed again it opens the overlay (and again goes back to Quantize). On T9 the overlay is the scale editor: two drawn keyboards (inputs, and outputs showing unused and doubled notes, and a dot on the last note played through the scale); hold a trig key as the source and press another to set its output (trigs 9-16 white keys, 2 3 5 6 7 black), knobs A-H: C..G, UP/DOWN flip to page 2: A-D G#..B and E rotates the wrap note (where the remap window starts, C by default); on any other track it opens that track's SCALE / TRANSPOSE switches (knobs A, B) and its last fired note, in > out, with TRN / SCL lit when transpose or the scale moved it. NO closes. The key resets to 0 on stop. The table, wrap note and switches are saved (eMMC block 0x6004e).
